summary.name: Future Tools
summary.one_liner: Future Tools is a curated AI news site and newsletter run by Matt Wolfe that covers AI headlines, commentary, interviews, and a directory of AI tools.
use_cases: keep up with daily AI headlines
watch AI news breakdowns on YouTube
read AI interviews and expert commentary
summary.what_it_does:
The page is a news and content hub for AI, with a headline feed updated throughout the day covering product launches from companies such as Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Meta. It includes a "AI News with Matt" section linking to commentary and interview videos from Matt Wolfe's YouTube channel. A free subscriber bonus offers an AI Income Database of side-hustle ideas and the tools for each, drawn from a list the site says tracks 4,500+ tools. The site also promotes a twice-weekly AI briefing email, which it says is read by 250,000+ people.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Curated daily AI news feed with headlines from major AI companies
Free AI Income Database of side-hustle ideas with tools for each
